corrected_findings.finding: Raw presentation allowed structured private assessment fields that assisted presentation rejected.
corrected_findings.result: All four original raw/assisted source/runtime cases now reject before output with explicit private-data error. Captured literal error text remains preserved.

limits: This is an ordinary bounded engineering review, not a formal red team or a clinical validation.
Pinned-source consistency is not proof of execution authenticity, operator identity, statistical independence or blinding.
Captured free-text errors can disclose actor/control information; preserving that raw text is intentional.
Other renderer/adjudication modules were active; this receipt reviews the core public projection and import contracts, not browser interaction.
non_findings: Both assigned cases and all twelve axis opportunities survived an omitted case and a partially assessed draft.
Invalid UTF-8 submission bytes were retained exactly and all assigned cases/axes remained pending.
